summary: The host pulls back from the kitchen window, strips off his apron, throws it over the smoking stove and starts to climb out of the window to escape.
framing: Wide full-figure shot of the kitchen wall, slightly high angle: stove at left, window at centre-right, plain green wall, purple tiled floor. Static.

cast.costume: light-blue suit, white apron tied at neck and waist (removed at 748-750)

props: white stove/oven at left, oven door with glass panel
white apron, worn by host until 750, then thrown; draped over the right side of the stove from 753
open sash window at centre-right with a view of a street and a red-roofed building

beats.action: back to camera, bent forward at the waist leaning out over the windowsill, both arms through the window; apron bow at the small of his back
grey-purple smoke plume rises continuously from the stove top at far left up out of frame; keeps billowing for the whole shot
pulls back in and straightens, still facing the window, hands on the sill
stands upright at the window, hands on the sash, head starting to turn left over his shoulder
spins round toward the room, hands drawn up to his chest; apron front now visible
facing 3/4 left, arms down and slightly behind him, looks left toward the stove, mouth a small frown
hands come forward at waist height, looks screen-right
one hand reaches up behind his neck to the apron strap; waist strings hang loose
bends forward and hauls the apron up over his head with both hands
apron off: bent at the waist facing right, holds the apron stretched out in both hands in front of him
swings round to face camera, whips the apron across his body toward the left
apron in mid-air at the stove's right side, just leaving the host's outstretched left-screen hand
apron lands draped over the right front corner of the stove and hangs there to the end of the shot
stands facing camera, legs straight, both arms flung out wide to the sides, eyes wide, small frown; held
arms start to drop, head dips, weight shifts to screen-right
turns right toward the window in a crouch, arms bent, looking down
facing 3/4 right, lifts his screen-right leg high toward the windowsill, arms pumping, head down; still rising on the last frame

notes: Animated mostly on twos; 750-752 are single-frame poses. Camera confirmed static (stove and window do not move). No dialogue in the shot.
